ops.text: You are in a dark and dank cavern.
Every step is darker and colder until dank and damp is the best description for what you have entered.  Bone chilling cold gives you a quick shudder as you peer into the darkness ahead.
This door is locked on this side.  Would you like to open it?
As you may have expected, some pretty nasty creatures are after you.
The lair of the Shantiles provides some needed cash!
A large beast is feasting on a badger type creature.  He spots you and gets even hungrier.
Deep beneath the bones and offal you discover some coin.
Three large beasts eye you as you enter their lair.  They attack on sight.
As you approach this large chest it reveals its illusion.  An immense beast attacks.
As you strike down the beast, it reverts back to its chest shape.
This door is locked on this side.  Would you like to open it?
As you may have expected, some pretty nasty creatures are after you.
The lair of the Shantiles provides some needed cash!
The lair of the Shantiles provides some needed cash!
This door is locked on this side.  Would you like to open it?
As you may have expected, some pretty nasty creatures are after you.
If you all exhale you can just squeeze into the narrow opening.  Will you enter?
A secret cave.  Inside is a treasure stash.
The recent rockslide has uncovered a box.  Would you like to take it?
It is locked.
The stench of this place is overwhelming.  Bones and offal fill this room.  You can barely stand the stench.
An immense wrought iron door looms between you and what lies beyond.  The door is barred on this side.  Faint growlings can be heard from beyond.  Would you like to open the door now?
The passage beyond the door is even more disgusting than the room you just came from.  You are barely able to breathe.
A huge pile of dung displays an unusual bulge.  Would you like to investigate?
After digging through the offal for what seems an eternity, you discover a locked box.
A dark cave heads off in a southerly direction, but it does not smell very good.
You discover the reason for the stench.  A couple of immense creatures loom out of the dark in front of you.  They sniff the air, get your scent and attack immedietly.
Finally, fresh air.  What is that!?!?!?  Where did they come from?  Prepare to defend yourself!
Having defeated the beasts, you wonder where they came from?

Two rocks slightly overlapping with one three feet in front of the other offered an interesting illusion.  You discover that the trail branches off to the west, and the smell gets stronger and the darkness seems darker.
A medium sized cave opens to the south and a narrow cave winds its way to the east.  A very strong smell wafts to your nostrils from the south.

Finally.  In front of you you spot a staircase heading up.  Unfortunately there is a guard.  It is the lady you remember playing dice with.  Dark hair highlights her ash-white skin.  A Vampire!  She hisses, "I took your gold the first time we met, .....
...now I will take your soul.  You see her body twist and contort as she chooses to attack you in bat form.  Her companions join her.
Having dispensed of the material plane form of the vampire, hopefully she will not get too much rest before you leave this place.

What a grizzly sight.  Behind this group of rocks rests the remains of a party of adventurers.  Six in total, their hollow cheeks still covered with patches of yellowish flesh.  The remaining flesh is so tight on the bones it loooks as though....
....all the fluid has been drained from the bodies.  Some of this parties supplies, weapons and armor is still intact.  It is old and uncomfortable, but will do in a pinch.
Would you like to take the staircase up to the surface?
Pressure plate.  A trap!  Spears fly out of the walls at you from both directions.
Above your head you see a trap door.  Would you like to go up?
A hole above you filters in sunlight.  Would you like to return to the surface?
A hole above you filters in sunlight.  Would you like to return to the surface?
A small stone shelf is hidden behind some stones.  On the shelf rests a candle.  The shelf is covered with dust, but the candle seems untouched by age.
A note is scrawled in the dust.  "Use this to summon your friends when hope is lost, but face the consequences of your summoning."
A cave winds it's way to the surface.  Would you like to enter the cave?

A ghastly sight attracts your attention.  The crunch beneath your feet gives away the burial sight of some poor adventurers.  All that is left of them are their crispy, chemically charred remains.  It looks as if they were running, as they are facing you.

You spot what you were looking for.  But wait, there are TWO dragons, and three young ones.  It looks as if they elder has found a mate, and they have bred.  They have not seen you yet.  Attack now, or come back later?
They were sitting on some treasure.  You are certain this would be a safe place to rest.
A guardian awaits here.  He attacks.
After killing the beast, you can scoop up his weapon.
A secret cave is empty save for a small stone.
You are in a dark and dank cavern.
